title: Point three feature notes at the bundle patch layers that replaced apps/cli/config

source.anchor: The production browser roster is assembled from `apps/cli/config/base.cordis.yml` plus `apps/cli/config/web.cordis.yml`

task:
Problem: three implemented feature notes state in present tense that the shipped composition lives in `apps/cli/config/base.cordis.yml` and `apps/cli/config/web.cordis.yml`: .agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-07-24-web-session-model-selector.md:21 ("The production browser roster is assembled from ..."), .agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-07-28-cross-workspace-resume.md:21 ("The shared base owns the default in `apps/cli/config/base.cordis.yml`: its `session-persistence-jsonl` row ..."), and .agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-07-31-web-default-search.md:13 ("`apps/cli/config/base.cordis.yml` explicitly mounts `dsh-web` ..."), with the same sentences in their .zh.md counterparts at the same lines. `apps/cli/config/` holds only `agent-presets/` today. The rows those notes describe live in packages/bundle/base/cordis.patch.yml (the `session-persistence-jsonl` row and the `dsh-web`, `dsh-web-search-deepseek`, and `dsh-tool-web` rows; `grep -n 'session-persistence-jsonl\|dsh-web-search-deepseek\|searchTimeoutMs' packages/bundle/base/cordis.patch.yml`) and packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml (the model-selection row; `grep -n 'model-selection' packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml`), the `dsh --profile` patch-layer bundles that packages/bundle/README.md documents. .agents/notes/README.md:13 requires an implemented note to be kept current with paths and names in the change that moves them; these three were missed.

Required: in each of the three notes, replace the stale paths with the bundle file that holds the row today, verifying each row by reading the bundle file before citing it, and link packages/bundle/README.md where the note explains how the launcher applies overlays instead of restating the mechanism; update each Chinese counterpart with the same minimal edit; re-record each pair with `pnpm run verify-translation-pairing --write <note>.md`.

Constraints: facts only — paths and names — never the decision, its alternatives, or its consequences; do not edit other notes, the bundles, or anything under .agents/notes/archived/; no new Agent Note (this is the maintenance the notes README mandates). The queue's mandatory coverage run names dsh-app-boot, the plugin that applies the bundles these notes now cite; it guards that package, not this edit, and passes before and after.
